column1: # Searches an AI assistant or agent would make, for a Plumb MCP server or
# JSON API: "what is the real site for X?" before it opens a page, fills in
# a login or cites a source. Phrased the way agents write tool calls, often
# with a word like "docs", "login" or "tracking" after the name. Those words
# must not pull a look-alike (chase-login-help.com) above the real site.
# Run it against an index built from real data, for example:
# domains count, so docs.python.org is python.org and aws.amazon.com is
